name: sheet-music
description: Music notation in PostScript: write ABC, engrave it to PDF, PNG or SVG with pscat, transpose it, and draw custom notation with the sm- glyph library. Runs headless; needs the pscat plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Write tunes as ABC and engrave them to PDF in PostScript with pscat.
interface.defaultPrompt: Write Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star as ABC and engrave it to a PDF with the sheet-music library.
